title: Tilt-Shift Diorama
description: Un style photographique tilt-shift photoréaliste qui transforme les scènes en modèles réduits miniatures. Il se caractérise par une profondeur de champ extrêmement faible avec une bande étroite de mise au point nette, un flou agressif au premier plan et à l'arrière-plan, et des textures lisses rappelant des jouets.
description_en: A photorealistic tilt-shift photography style that transforms scenes into miniature scale models. It features an extremely shallow depth of field with a narrow band of sharp focus, aggressive foreground and background blur, and smooth, toy-like material textures.
description_fr: Un style photographique tilt-shift photoréaliste qui transforme les scènes en modèles réduits miniatures. Il se caractérise par une profondeur de champ extrêmement faible avec une bande étroite de mise au point nette, un flou agressif au premier plan et à l'arrière-plan, et des textures lisses rappelant des jouets.
prompt: Photorealistic macro photography and miniature diorama rendering technique simulating a high-end tilt-shift lens effect. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. The execution transforms the scene into a pristine scale model, utilizing smooth material textures reminiscent of matte plastic, painted wood, and cast resin, deliberately omitting microscopic real-world grit to enhance the toy-like illusion. Lighting consists of soft, diffuse global illumination mimicking a studio setup, contrasted by localized, glowing emissive light sources that bloom into distinct, circular bokeh patterns in the blurred regions. The color grading relies on a palette where a dominant {{primary_color}} establishes the environment, sharply punctuated by vibrant {{accent_color}} focal points and subtle {{secondary_color}} ambient reflections. The structural hallmark is the aggressive manipulation of spatial dynamics via an extremely shallow depth of field. A narrow, precise slice of the scene remains in razor-sharp, macro-level focus, capturing crisp, volumetric edges. Both the immediate foreground and distant background dissolve rapidly into heavy, creamy optical blur. This forced perspective creates an intimate atmosphere, inviting the viewer to examine a meticulously crafted, artificial miniature world. tilt-shift photography, macro lens, miniature faking, diorama effect, shallow depth of field, optical blur, bokeh, scale model textures, toy-like aesthetics, photorealistic rendering, volumetric lighting, forced perspective, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Subjects and vehicles move with a slightly stiff, mechanical cadence, resembling motorized toys or stop-motion models traversing a static diorama.
video.camera: The camera remains mostly locked or performs extremely slow, smooth lateral tracking shots that maintain the fixed horizontal plane of sharp focus.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy optical blur, bokeh shapes, and crisp focal plane must remain perfectly stable, avoiding any focus hunting or flickering in the global illumination.
video.avoid: Avoid rapid camera pans, deep focus, handheld shake, motion blur on fast objects, or realistic fluid dynamics that break the miniature scale illusion.
